verdict: Generator and collector have no correctness finding in this review; fix split artifact retention before production re-splits. Host replacement and kernel admission are not cleared.

findings.problem: Retained subcover filenames use only cube and leaf. Distinct splits have distinct claims/receipts but overwrite the same subcovers-retained CNF, LRAT and JSON objects. Re-splitting a leaf at depth 8 can destroy the depth-6 proof required by a completed split's receipts.
findings.reproduction: RetainedSubcovers.test_two_splits_keep_both_exact_artifact_triples calls the real retained certifier and worker upload code into LocalStore for two different blocking lists of one leaf; only one metadata file survives before patch. Solver/checker output is mocked, so this is an artifact-lifecycle test, not proof verification.
findings.fix: retain_split_identity.patch puts the full split_sha256 in both producer and uploader filenames. Both artifact triples survive and their exact CNF/proof hashes match the corresponding ledgers after patch.
findings.migration: No split fleet was reported launched. If historical subcover artifacts exist, preserve and validate them by split_sha256 from their JSON; the patch does not recover overwritten files or migrate old keys.

findings.problem: --replace terminates the old host without verifying a saved checkpoint. The new host silently continues when its state download fails. Mirroring also uses check=False and ignores upload failure, so the existence and currency of the saved state are not guaranteed. A replacement can lose historical spending while preserving the nominal full cap.
findings.reproduction: probe_host.py mocks all cloud calls and shows terminate-instances occurs without any checkpoint read; it then runs the exact generated restore condition with a shell aws stub returning 42 and observes continuation to the watch boundary.
findings.fix_required: Before retiring the only budget watcher, validate a durable checkpoint and transfer a pinned snapshot that the new host must restore successfully. Distinguish an intentional fresh run with an explicit remaining cap from a replacement. Retire the stale manifest watcher before exposing expanded work; freight/setup/launch followed by replacement leaves a premature-STOP window.
findings.current_workaround: Claude's clean-drain, terminal-fleet verification, then fresh batch-2 host with a reduced remaining residual cap avoids relying on --replace. Do not silently restore an unrelated stale checkpoint when using a fresh-accounting budget.
findings.patch_status: Not fixed by the retention patch; independent replacement work remains.

findings.problem: The statement that external receipts instantiate the Lean SubLeafChecked/SubCoverChecked propositions and leave no Lean-side gap is stronger than the code. These propositions are CNF.Unsat, and the composition theorem takes proofs of them. The collector outputs metadata and does not produce those proofs.
findings.distinction: Checked external UNSAT evidence with exact CNF identity supports the external mathematical argument. It does not itself discharge hSeven inside Lean or establish an unconditional kernel-checked capstone. Neither emitter identity nor JSON completeness changes this boundary.
findings.suggested_documentation: The external evidence route has the needed split formulas and a Lean-checked conditional composition theorem. The collector establishes receipt completeness and exact CNF binding. Admission of those external checks as Lean Unsat proofs remains separate. The LRAT route still needs SubLeaf/SubCover checker interfaces and successful check proofs for the concrete certificates; retained subcovers alone cannot replay discarded subleaf proofs.
findings.release_gate: Do not mark hSeven discharged or remove its hypotheses on the basis of this review.

positive_findings.formula_identity: Subleaf appends each negated blocking literal as a unit, preserving order; subcover appends each blocking clause verbatim, preserving list order. DIMACS +/- (v+1) matches the emitter and the Lean definitions.
positive_findings.composition: cnf_unsat_of_blocking_clauses applies to arbitrary blocking clauses. Checked subcover and every checked subleaf suffice; the lookahead generator does not need to be trusted for this implication.
positive_findings.generator: 200 seeded six-variable formulas, four primary variables and two auxiliary variables; 572 uniform/best-first trees; 8064 model/tree pairs exhaustively checked for exact coverage and disjointness. No lost model, overlap, or leaked trail state found. This is bounded testing, not a general proof of the Python generator.
positive_findings.collector: Independent fixtures use actual h7_common hashes over synthetic input bytes. Missing cover/leaf, cross-split and cross-leaf substitutions, altered CNF hashes, changed cover lists, bad solver/checker pins, solver SAT status, missing verification and early checker closure are rejected. Empty and malformed covers do not certify vacuously. Complete receipts remain valid under reordering and duplication.
positive_findings.identity_receipts: All seven stored fixtures regenerate byte-for-byte from pinned inputs and split specs; fixture and emitter hashes equal the stored Lean receipt. No fresh Lean elaboration was performed: local Docker is unavailable and this review launched no remote job.
positive_findings.ordinary_leaves: Prior room 53169 review found no ordinary-leaf regression; existing Cube methods are AST-identical, five differential batch scenarios agree, and the ledger gains split_sha256:null.

deployment: Proposed patch only; owner campaign tree and live infrastructure untouched
lean_proof_status: No new Lean proof, certificate admission, or global goal completion claimed
